notes: The theme list shows one round dot again. The three-band chip that appeared last release read as a strip of random colours on a phone, so it is gone and the dot is back — the accent, or the accent-and-second gradient when the theme moves.

That theme is called Lagoon now, because the palette is a deep teal-black with a mint accent over aqua and a theme should be named after what it looks like. Same theme, same key underneath: if you were wearing it, you still are.

The tabs are taller and they drag properly. A sideways swipe on the settings tabs can no longer be stolen by the page behind them, the strip settles on a tab instead of between two, and opening a tab scrolls it into view so the one you are in is never half off the edge.
The bottom row got the same treatment: 44px pills instead of 36, 48 in the cloud layout, with the same snap. In the cloud layout that row is the whole navigation, so it is sized like it.

The widget’s cover art is rounded now — an 18% corner, drawn by the app before the cover is handed to the widget, because the widget’s ImageView can scale a bitmap but cannot clip one. The preview in Settings shows the same shape.
Nothing else moved — the player, the library, the albums, the lyrics, the downloader, the Studio and the audio graph are untouched.
